The canonical assessment classifier recognized 'exam' but not 'examination', so Midterm Examination II was registered as a graded artifact and exported as a no-brief Assignment Briefs handoff.

Prerequisite DOCX rendering prepended a bold term to definitions that already began with the same term, producing X:X echoes; duplicate dependency edges could print the same primer twice.
